# Synthetic PDF fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate-pdf-fixtures.py` using actual reportlab, Pillow
and pypdf. No personal documents, credentials, fake vectors or OCR responses.

- `migration.pdf`: two text pages (database migration, Spring Boot permissions).
- `scanned-invoice.pdf`: pixels only; Laptop / CNY 5999.00 / documentation IP
  192.0.2.42. No invisible text layer. Requires real OCR in model acceptance.
- `encrypted.pdf`: intentionally password-protected, rejected by the extractor.
- `too-many-pages.pdf`: 65 pages, rejected before extraction/rendering.

The generator is deterministic; two consecutive runs produced identical hashes.
Text pages and scanned invoice were rendered to PNG and visually checked.
